title: A verification step destroyed the thing it was verifying
problem: Confirm that regenerating an output produces the same output.
failure: The instruction said to re-run the generator and said nothing about the previous output. The generator writes to fixed paths, so the re-run overwrote the artifact under comparison. Only its recorded digest survived.
correction: Logged as a defect in the instruction: a task that re-runs a generator must state what happens to the previous output.
transfer: A check that consumes its own evidence cannot be repeated, and its result cannot be re-examined.
limits: FIXTURE. Test data for tests/retrieval_soundness_R01.py. Generalised from a real finding in a private lane; carries no path, digest or identifier from it.
author: FIXTURE
